services.name: Skydance Paragliding
services.desc: As the days get longer in the Spring and snow coverage is good I am offering a few clinics in Speedriding between Feburarys and April 15th. Each pilot must have Skis, Skins, and a Helmet along with being a fairly comfortable skier. There's often nice weather mid March and a perfect time to start training on paragliders and I will take a few folks to their P2 ideally before May 1st.. This year I hope to have a scooter tow system in place to speed up the training. Otherwise Training sites in South Anchorage start working quite well to learn the basics before moving up for higher flights in the mountains Get your Paragliding, Speedflying, Hike and Fly setups here at the best prices.
